mediaScrapbook.headline: WORLD CUP CHAMPIONS
mediaScrapbook.subheadline: India finish the 2026 campaign on top.
mediaScrapbook.body: India National XI won the T20 World Cup Final against England National XI. The title is backed by the completed canonical tournament fixtures in this QA save.

mediaScrapbook.headline: WORLD TEST CHAMPIONSHIP SECURED
mediaScrapbook.subheadline: India win the 2027 final after qualifying through the cycle.
mediaScrapbook.body: India National XI defeated Pakistan National XI in the completed World Test Championship Final. The cycle standings, final fixture, and result are stored in this isolated QA save.

mediaScrapbook.headline: A TEST WIN IN AUSTRALIA
mediaScrapbook.subheadline: India secure the away result at Southern Colosseum.
mediaScrapbook.body: India National XI won the canonical Test at Australia’s home venue, Southern Colosseum. Scorecard: India 494/5 & 244/0; Australia 54/10 & 63/10.

mediaScrapbook.headline: A TEST WIN IN ENGLAND
mediaScrapbook.subheadline: India claim the away Test at Headrow Ground.
mediaScrapbook.body: India National XI won the canonical Test at England’s home venue, Headrow Ground. Scorecard: India 433/8 & 131/2; England 81/10 & 62/10.
